verdict_reason: The new MDM section is accurate against rules.js, stub.js, species-check.js and the fixture, but the older rules section it sits under now names removed constants and states wrong unweaned and Cow rules.

todos.issue: The PR added 'Codes and species from MDM' but left the older sections above it describing the picker-name catalogue the PR removed, so the page now contradicts itself and the code. Line 10: 'the Cow Domestic/Game type mapping', but rules.js keys the split on code 0102. Lines 35-37: PERMANENT_ADDRESS_COMMODITIES must be in IDENTIFIED_COMMODITIES. Both constants are gone. The rule is now PERMANENT_ADDRESS_SPECIES against IDENTIFIED_CODES, which index.test.js pins as 'Should find every permanent-address species MDM holds under an identified code', and line 52 describes it a second time. Lines 38-40: 'only cattle has them', but UNWEANED_CODES is [0102, 0103], so swine have them too. Lines 41-42: CPH_EXEMPT_COMMODITY_CODES is now CPH_EXEMPT_CODES, and 'not picker name' describes a removed design. Line 28: fish is the example of a commodity with no identifiers, but the MDM data offers no fish code. Lines 7-8 list only index.js and stub.js as the service, leaving out rules.js, where the new section says the rules live.
todos.fix: Must: the page describes one current set of commodity rules, by the names in rules.js, with each rule stated once and no claim the code contradicts. One way: rewrite 'The commodity rules' in code and species terms (0102 type split, PERMANENT_ADDRESS_SPECIES under IDENTIFIED_CODES, unweaned for 0102 and 0103, CPH_EXEMPT_CODES), use a code MDM offers (poultry, say) as the no-identifier example, add rules.js to the file list, and merge the permanent-address bullet from the MDM section into it.
